title: Do-No-Harm: a missed directive on an application-code task still blocks and is repaired by the developer, even when the judge labels it IMAGE_BUILD
source: negative control for IMAGE-BUILD-PLATFORM-FACT (example 01, 11-16): the facet must never excuse the developer's own code
mechanism: IMAGE-BUILD-PLATFORM-FACT: the IMAGE_BUILD label applies only to a finding attributed to an infrastructure or CI/CD plan task (typed task kinds); CODE-01's missing POST /api/v1/events route stays blocking, is seeded on apps/event-router/main.py and the repair adds it
